description: [Jobs] Natural language job search. Describe what you are looking for and the AI parses it into structured filters. Returns one page and has no pagination input. Results preserve matchScoreReason and count metadata: totalIsLowerBound=true means the total is a lower bound; total=null means unknown. Explain countGuidance, then continue with trackly_search_jobs using supported structured filters and offset. Never repeat this natural-language query to paginate: it returns the same first page.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

query.description: Natural language search query, e.g. "PM jobs at fintech companies in SF"
